title: Elevate UI Design: Master CSS 'text-underline-offset' for Pristine Link Underlines
tweet: Transform your UI links! Learn how CSS 'text-underline-offset' creates elegant, readable underlines that avoid descenders. Boost #CSS_typography & #UI_design UX instantly. #WebFonts
tip: Enhance readability and aesthetics by preventing underlines from cutting through letter descenders (like 'g', 'p', 'q'). Use 'text-underline-offset' to lift the underline baseline. Pair it with 'text-decoration-thickness' for perfect weight, ensuring your #UI_design is pixel-perfect and accessible. This is especially useful for complex #web_fonts.
